name: pointable-context
description: Pointable Context fixture tools, opt-in Desktop Quick Look, and an App Server-owned conversation client.

interface.shortDescription: Pointable lookup in Desktop or an App Server task.
interface.longDescription: Run the headless fixture-only MCP probe, explicitly manage the experimental Codex Desktop local-workspace companion, or start a separate App Server-owned conversation client through dedicated Skills. The conversation client keeps Chat, selected-text Quick Look, visible object references, and later Agent questions on one supported task surface. It remains a local research client, not a DCPM/CWA Dashboard or a portable public host contract.
defaultPrompt: Run the Pointable Context fixture probe for GOV-1.
Resolve ARCH-7 inside the bundled mini-project without reading detail yet.
Show the fixture source, revision, and freshness for a returned entity reference.
Use the Pointable Context Workspace skill to bind this task to an explicit local workspace.
Use the Pointable Context Conversation skill to start a same-surface local research client for this workspace.
